critique: The render has a warm fire palette on black and visibly evolves from frame 1 to frame 4, but it reads as a centered radial explosion: a blown-out white circular core expands while small orange/yellow dots scatter in every direction. It does not resemble a directional Rocket Fire effect, and the large opaque core obscures the flame texture rather than showing a shaped rocket flame or trailing fire.

suggestions.why: Increase particle velocity so the effect develops a directional rocket-like fire stream instead of accumulating as a stationary central ball.
Tighten directional spread so particles form a concentrated flame trail rather than a broad radial burst.
Reduce maximum particle size to prevent the saturated white central disk from dominating the fire texture.
Lower particle density along with the smaller sprites so the flame remains detailed and does not overbuild into an opaque blob.
